title: Charta Health, which offers AI-powered tools to automate medical chart review, billing, and coding workflows, raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners (Jessica Hagen/MobiHealthNews)
summary: Jessica Hagen / MobiHealthNews: Charta Health, which offers AI-powered tools to automate medical chart review, billing, and coding workflows, raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners — The round is the company's third in less than two years and brings its total funding to $85 million. — Global Investing
